1–2 hours for the 4 tasks (repeatable every 20 hours)

In the depths of {wiki:Hellgate}, beneath Ab'Dendriel, lives a small group of elves atoning for the sins of their ancestors. {npc:Ashari} has four daily tasks: watering the garden, sterilising diseased mushrooms, collecting flames from fire elementals and growing wild magic for the shaman. Each task gives experience and, if you do all four on the same day, you get a bonus (2000 XP and, rarely, a {item:Pannier Backpack}).

Use a special copper key to open the door on the path that leads to Hellgate. Once there, look for those who atone for the sins of their ancestors. Offer your help and make their lives easier, at least for a while. If you manage to complete all the tasks in a single day, the penitents may reward you with something special.
{item:Key 3012} to open the Hellgate doors (if they are not open).
{spell:Levitate} or 6 {item:Parcel|Parcels} (or equivalent) to be able to leave Hellgate
optional, against drunkenness in the fire cave
Bonus (all 4 on the same day): 2,000 XP — total 10,600 XP
Shortcut east of Ashari (5 uses per character) after the first bonus
When you receive the daily bonus for the first time (all four tasks on the same day; {key:bonus} to {npc:Ashari}).
It is right next to Ashari, to the east, and goes past the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}. You can only use it 5 times per character, with no way to get uses back.
You can accept all four tasks at once. Each one can be repeated 20 hours after you hand it in.
If you do everything in a row, leave **Watering** for last: the water in the flask drains away after about 15 minutes.
Put the {item:Firecatcher Urn} on a hotkey: you will use it many times in a row.
Entering Hellgate is one-way: to leave you have to take a long way round (see the {wiki:Route:Hellgate|Hellgate exit route}).

Go to **Ab'Dendriel** (by boat, you arrive at {npc:Captain Seagull}, coming from Thais, Carlin, Venore or Edron). Look for the staircase in the middle of the city and **go down two floors**. Follow the path **south** and then **east** until you find a door with a sign saying *Hellgate*.

If the door is closed, use the {item:Key 3012}. Go through and, just to the **north**, there is another door that also needs the {item:Key 3012}. (The portal on the **west** side of this room takes you outside — it's not that one.)
Go through the north door and enter the portal to {wiki:Hellgate}.

Once you enter the portal there is no way back: to leave you have to take a rather long way round (see the last section, *Leaving Hellgate*). Bring a {item:Rope} and {spell:Levitate} or 6 {item:Parcel|Parcels}.
Go up the stairs and cross the bridge to the **west**. Follow the cave west until you see a path to the **south**. Go south and follow the cave **southeast** until you find {npc:Ashari}.
Say {key:hi} and {key:tasks}. Then ask for each task with its keyword: {key:watering}, {key:mushroom}, {key:fire} and {key:magic}. You can accept all four at once.
Talking to Ashari about the tasks
Say {key:mushroom} to {npc:Ashari}. You receive a {item:Trained Fire Bug}.

Head **west** to the bottom of the cave. When the cave splits into 3 paths, take the **middle** one, to the **southwest**. Follow it and go down the hole at the end. Then go down the ramp into a {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} cave.
Route: yellow = Ashari, green = quest hole

Use the {item:Trained Fire Bug} on **5** sick mushrooms scattered around the cave. Each success shows *"The mushroom has been sterilised and is no longer infected."*; on the fifth one *"...You treated enough mushrooms to keep the spreading infection at bay."*
Using the Trained Fire Bug on an infected mushroom
Go up the ramp and the hole you came down through (use the {item:Rope}), go back to {npc:Ashari} and say {key:mushroom}.
It is the hardest task and usually the most time-consuming.
Say {key:fire} to {npc:Ashari}. You receive a {item:Firecatcher Urn}.
Go to the far **west** of the cave and, when it splits into 3, head **northwest**. Go down the hole at the end of the cave.
Route: yellow = Ashari, green = quest hole
Always head **east**, cross the bridge and go down the hole. Then go **west**, cross the bridge and turn **north** straight away. Go down the hole you find there.
Hole to the Furious Fire Elementals cave

Kill {creature:Furious Fire Elemental|Furious Fire Elementals} and use the {item:Firecatcher Urn} on the corpse **within the next 10 seconds**. You need **5** flames. About 70% of the time it fails, and the corpse stops being usable whether you succeed or fail, so expect to kill around 17 elementals. The spawn can't be blocked.
If you stay in the cave for a long time, the fumes make you drunk. Step out for a bit while waiting for the respawn or use a {item:Dwarven Ring}.
Using the Firecatcher Urn on a dead Furious Fire Elemental
The urn turns into a {item:Hot Firecatcher Urn}. Go back the same way, climbing the holes with the {item:Rope}, to {npc:Ashari} and say {key:fire}.
Task complete: the urn gets hot (Hot Firecatcher Urn)
Say {key:magic} to {npc:Ashari}. You receive an {item:Empty Receptacle}.
Go to the far **west** until the cave splits into 3. Choose the **northwest** passage and go down the hole at the end. Then head **northwest** and go down the next hole.
Route: yellow = Ashari, green = quest hole
Collect the magic in the right order
In the crystal cave there are coloured sparks of magic. Use the {item:Empty Receptacle} on them **exactly in this order**:
If you get the order wrong the collection resets and you have to start again from red.
The sparks of magic in the crystal cave

The receptacle becomes a {item:Filled Receptacle}. Go up the two holes with the {item:Rope}, return to the camp and talk to {npc:Larfion the Shaman} (not to Ashari): {key:hi}, {key:something}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}.
Be careful what you say to Larfion: if you say the wrong thing, the task is reset.
Hand the Filled Receptacle to Larfion the Shaman
If you are doing all four tasks, do this one last: the water drains from the flask after about 15 minutes.
Say {key:watering} to {npc:Ashari}. You receive an {item:Elven Vial}.
Follow the cave **west** of Ashari until it splits into three paths. Take the path furthest **south** and go down the hole at the end.
Route: yellow = Ashari, green = quest hole
You are in a big cave with leaves on the floor. Head **northeast**, then **south**, and go down the hole.

Follow the cave **south** to a small pond. Only one water square works: the one **without tree roots**, on the **north** side, right behind the tree. Use the {item:Elven Vial} on that square to get a {item:Filled Elven Vial} (*"The water seems to develop a life of its own as it pours slowly into the vial."*).
The only water square that works: no roots, on the north side, behind the tree
Return to {npc:Ashari} the same way (go up the holes with the {item:Rope}) and say {key:watering}.
On the way back, in the leaf cave, you can be attacked by up to five groups of 3 {creature:Leaf Golem|Leaf Golems} (depending on your level).
Leaf Golems that can attack you on the way back through the leaf cave
If you completed all **four** tasks on the same day you received them, say {key:bonus} to {npc:Ashari}. You receive 2,000 extra XP and, rarely, a {item:Pannier Backpack}.
When you receive the bonus, a **shortcut** is unlocked right to the **east** of Ashari, which goes past the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} and leads directly to the {wiki:Hellgate Library}.
The shortcut can only be used **5 times per character** and there is no way to recover uses.
The Ab'Dendriel portal is one-way. To leave, follow the Hellgate exit route ({wiki:Route:Hellgate|Route:Hellgate}). You need a {item:Rope} and {spell:Levitate} or 6 {item:Parcel|Parcels}.

From {npc:Ashari}, go back the way you came (**northwest** and then **north**) to the cave that heads **west** from the entrance stairs. Continue along that long corridor to the **west** (there are only {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}) and go down the hole at the end. Then go **east** along another long corridor (more Skeletons) and go down the next hole.
Exit route 1: the corridor to the west and the hole at the end
Exit route 2: the corridor to the east and the next hole
Leaving Hellgate 2: going up with the rope and the Rotworm cave

Go **west** and loop round the long corridor (only {creature:Spider|Spiders} and Skeletons) to the yellow circle on the map, where you climb up with the {item:Rope}. Then head **south-east** (a few {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}), go down the hole, walk a little to the **south** (2 {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}) and climb up. Follow the path **south** (more Ghouls and Rotworms) and climb up again. Then go **south** and go down the **first** hole you see.
Exit route 3: follow the corridor to the yellow circle and climb up with the rope
Exit route 4 and 5: Rotworm cave and the first hole to the south
Do not stray: other holes on this path have Elves and a {creature:Giant Spider}, and the second rope spot to the south has {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and 1 Ghoul.
Leaving Hellgate 3: the Ghoul room and the 2 floors

Go **west**: you find about 15 {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, about 5 {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} and 2 {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} (not all at the same time). Cross the big room along the **south** wall and go down the hole. Then head **north-west** (no monsters), go up **2 floors** with {spell:Levitate} or by stacking 6 {item:Parcel|Parcels}, and climb the ladder.
Exit route: go up 2 floors with Levitate or Parcels and then the ladder
In the big room there are also {creature:Elder Bonelord|Elder Bonelords}, and someone may have pulled them close to your path.
Leaving Hellgate 4: up to the surface

Head **southwest** and go up through the hole (do not take the hole to the **southeast**: it takes you down, to the lava floor). You may need to pull a lever: it lowers the bridge you have to cross one floor up (it may already be open). From here there are many {creature:Wasp|Wasps}, but there is only one way up: follow it until you come out on the surface, near Ab'Dendriel. In the city, {npc:Captain Seagull} takes you to Carlin, Edron, Thais, Venore or Yalahar ({key:hi}, the name of the city, {key:yes}).
Exit route: climb up through the hole to the south-west
Exit route: the bridge lever and the path to the surface
There is an alternative route out of Hellgate, through {wiki:Draconia} and the {wiki:Redbone Castle}, but it is far more dangerous.
The tasks are daily: each one becomes available 20 hours after you hand it in.
Since 2 December 2014 the quest no longer gives money (it used to give 106 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}), because it was heavily exploited by cheaters.
Also known as Hellgate Daily Tasks.
